title: Discussing How to Get Better Relative Speedups for Training Models

cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: In the last video, we made a function called createmodel, which does what it says.
cues.zh: 上一段影片建立了 create_model 函式，顧名思義，

cues.en: It creates a model and the transforms to go along with it, namely a Resnet 50 model and the transforms from training it on image net.
cues.zh: 建立模型與相應轉換，也就是 ResNet-50，以及它在 ImageNet 訓練時使用的轉換。

cues.en: And we also hinted at the fact that PyTorch 2.0 relative speedups will be most noticeable when as much of the GPU as possible is being used.
cues.zh: 也提到，盡可能充分使用 GPU，PyTorch 2.0 的相對加速會最明顯。

cues.en: So in the intro we discussed that one of the main costs of training time is bandwidth costs.
cues.zh: 導入影片談過，訓練時間的一大成本是頻寬。

cues.en: So transferring data from memory to the GPU and you want to reduce that as much as possible.
cues.zh: 也就是把資料從記憶體搬到 GPU，要盡量減少這個成本。

cues.en: And one of the ways to do that is with Operator Fusion.
cues.zh: 其中一種做法是運算子融合。

cues.en: And then another way to do it is graph capture.
cues.zh: 另一種是計算圖擷取。

cues.en: Now graph capture isn't specifically for reducing bandwidth costs.
cues.zh: 計算圖擷取並不是專門降低頻寬成本，

cues.en: It's to memorize the operations model graph or a PyTorch model needs to do ahead of time so it doesn't have to look them up while it's doing it.
cues.zh: 而是預先記住模型計算圖或 PyTorch 模型需要做的操作，不必執行時再查。

cues.en: But let's jump down into 2.2, which is where we're up to Speedups are most noticeable when a large
cues.zh: 來到目前的 2.2 小節，當 GPU 很大一部分

cues.en: portion of the GPU is being used and if you hear some crows chirping in the background, well, that's one of the unmissable sounds of Australia.
cues.zh: 被使用時，加速最明顯。如果聽到背景烏鴉叫，那是澳洲不可能錯過的聲音之一。

cues.en: So there's a bunch of them I think you call a group of crows a murder in a tree not far outside my window and they're singing their afternoon song.
cues.zh: 窗外不遠的樹上有一群，我想一群烏鴉英文叫 a murder，牠們在唱午後的歌。

cues.en: So if you hear them, enjoy it with me.
cues.zh: 如果聽到了，就和我一起欣賞。

cues.en: So let's write this down.
cues.zh: 寫下來。

cues.en: Speedups are most noticeable when a large portion of the GPU is being used.
cues.zh: 充分利用 GPU 時，加速會最明顯。

cues.en: So let's break this down a little bit more.
cues.zh: 再拆開說明。

cues.en: We've given an example before, but let's make this a bit more concrete.
cues.zh: 之前舉過例子，現在更具體一點。

cues.en: So since modern GPUs are so fast that they're fast at performing operations, so tensor manipulation
cues.zh: 現代 GPU 執行操作很快，例如張量操作、

cues.en: matrix multiplications, you will often notice the majority of relative.
cues.zh: 矩陣乘法，因此通常會注意到大部分的相對，

cues.en: Now I say relative because that's an important point, is that it won't always be like for like speed
cues.zh: 我說相對，是因為這很重要，不一定是逐項完全相同條件的

cues.en: ups, but they will be relative speed ups, relative speed ups when as much data as possible is on the
cues.zh: 加速，而是當 GPU 上放入盡可能多的資料時，相對加速更

cues.en: GPU.
cues.zh: 明顯。

cues.en: So in practice you generally want to use as much of your GPU memory as possible.
cues.zh: 實務上，一般希望盡可能使用 GPU 記憶體。

cues.en: You don't want GPU memory and compute power to go to waste, right?
cues.zh: 不希望浪費 GPU 記憶體與運算能力，對吧？

cues.en: So what are some ways to do that?
cues.zh: 有哪些方式？

cues.en: Well, the first one is by increasing the batch size.
cues.zh: 第一，增加 batch_size。

cues.en: So previously throughout the course we've been using the ever reliable batch size of 32.
cues.zh: 前面整門課一直使用可靠的批次大小 32。

cues.en: Now that is good.
cues.zh: 這很好。

cues.en: But as you start to train larger and larger models on bigger and better GPUs, you'll likely want to increase that batch size, namely putting more GPU or more data.
cues.zh: 但當模型越來越大、GPU 越來越強，可能會想增加 batch_size，也就是放更多 GPU，或者說更多資料，

cues.en: Sorry.
cues.zh: 不好意思。

cues.en: So we've been using batch size 32, but for GPUs with a larger.
cues.zh: 我們一直用 32，但對記憶體

cues.en: Memory.
cues.zh: 容量較大

cues.en: Capacity you'll generally want to use as large as possible e.g. 128 256 512 etcetera.
cues.zh: 的 GPU，通常希望盡可能大，例如 128、256、512 等等。

cues.en: A multiple of eight is generally good practice and then you want to also increase the data size.
cues.zh: 使用八的倍數通常是不錯的做法。接著也能增加資料大小。

cues.en: So for example, instead of using images that are 32 by 32 use.
cues.zh: 例如不用 32 乘 32 的影像，改用，

cues.en: 2 to 4 by 2 to 4 or even three.
Three six by three, three six.
Now, I'm not quite sure what the default image sizes are across the standardization of different image
cues.zh: 我不太確定不同影像模型常見的標準預設影像

cues.en: models, but this is something that you can explore with the the main point here is that it's increasing
cues.zh: 大小，不過這可以自行探索。重點是增加

cues.en: in size and that could be also you could use an increased embedding size.
cues.zh: 大小，也可能是增加資料的嵌入大小。

cues.en: For your data.
cues.zh: 也就是 embedding size。

cues.en: And now let's keep going on.
cues.zh: 繼續。

cues.en: We want to increase the model size.
cues.zh: 增加模型大小。

cues.en: So, for example, instead of we hinted at this one before using a model with one mil parameters.
cues.zh: 例如前面暗示過，不用一百萬參數的模型，

cues.en: Use a model with ten millimetres parameters, and now that might actually be considered a small model in today's world.
cues.zh: 改用一千萬參數的模型，現在這種規模甚至可能仍算小模型。

cues.en: But we're not going for a very specific examples here.
cues.zh: 但這裡不是要指定非常精確的例子。

cues.en: We're just saying that you'll notice the trend is just increase, increase, increase as much as you can put on the GPU as possible.
cues.zh: 只是說，趨勢是增加、增加、再增加，盡量把更多資料與運算放到 GPU。

cues.en: That's a good thing.
cues.zh: 這是好事。

cues.en: And then we want to decrease data transfer.
cues.zh: 接著要減少資料傳輸。

cues.en: So this is the one thing we want to decrease.
cues.zh: 這是唯一要減少的項目。

cues.en: So since bandwidth bandwidth costs, so transferring data will slow down our GPU.
cues.zh: 因為頻寬成本，也就是資料傳輸，會拖慢 GPU，

cues.en: Because it wants to compute on data.
cues.zh: 它想要對資料運算。

cues.en: But if it doesn't have the data, it can't compute on it.
cues.zh: 但如果沒有資料，就無法運算。

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: So you want to use as much CPU as power as you can to put as much data as you can on the GPU and avoid
cues.zh: 所以，要盡可能利用 CPU 的能力，把資料放到 GPU，避免

cues.en: unnecessary transfers, which is one of the things that PyTorch does behind the scenes with Operator Fusion.
cues.zh: 不必要的傳輸。這正是 PyTorch 在背後透過運算子融合做的事情之一。

cues.en: Instead of writing and saving data and computing it, it just computes as much as it can through a series of operations.
cues.zh: 不是一再寫入、儲存資料，再計算，而是透過一系列操作，盡可能連續計算。

cues.en: So let's go here.
cues.zh: 這裡。

cues.en: As a result of doing the above, your relative speedups should be better.
cues.zh: 做了上述事情後，相對加速應該更好。

cues.en: Overall training time may take longer, but not linearly.
cues.zh: 總訓練時間可能變長，但不是線性增加。

cues.en: So although we're increasing here, you might increase the batch size by four x.
cues.zh: 例如，雖然把批次大小提高四倍，

cues.en: It doesn't mean to 128.
cues.zh: 也就是到 128，

cues.en: It doesn't mean that the training time will increase by four x.
cues.zh: 不表示訓練時間也會增加四倍。

cues.en: The same with data size, the same with model size, the same with data transfer.
cues.zh: 資料大小、模型大小、資料傳輸也一樣。

cues.en: It's not a linear increase just because you're doing more.
cues.zh: 不是做得更多，時間就一定線性增加。
